title: 第541章 混沌双宝压元始二圣退走显从容第540章 元始暴怒斥二圣道祖布局圣人惊
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
风泽残墟虚空，四圣对峙的死寂僵气，依旧沉沉压覆天地。
漫天破碎的虚空裂纹尚未愈合，残存的巽风、泽水法则碎流缓缓消散，方才剑拔弩张的对峙余威，仍旧震荡四极八荒。
远处九天之上，诸圣圣念悬空观望，无声的注视如同亘古天平，悬在每一位圣人头顶，压得整场博弈不敢彻底爆碎。
元始立在高空，白衣垂落，周身阐清正法凛冽如霜。方才被西方二圣硬顶回来的怒火，死死憋在胸腔，颜面尽失。
在他多年认知里，西方向来是夹缝乞运、遇强必退、惧罚畏势的旁门，哪怕占得机缘，也必然心虚气短、不敢硬刚玄门正统。
可今日，这两个素来退让的圣人，偏偏在他面前掀了桌子。
而此刻的准提、接引，心境早已彻底翻覆，完成了脱胎换骨的蜕变。
方才立宏愿、锁圣位、融双宝的后怕，彻底褪去。
那一份隔绝天道、身死道消的绝境恐惧，已然化作最坚实的底气。
二圣心神澄澈，彻底想通透了此番全盘棋局。
他们看似被套上永世枷锁、沦为天道工具人，看似失去了圣人自在，却也因此彻底站在了天道大势一侧。
此番入局夺宝，看似违规私取机缘，实则是天道默许、道祖暗中排布的定局。
否则以鸿钧执掌诸天秩序、掌控圣人奖惩的权柄，绝不会任由二人顶着违规的名头，安稳持有混沌层级至宝。
所谓紫霄追责、天道惩戒，看似悬顶利剑，实则早已形同虚设。
他们不会死，不敢死，也不会被重罚。天道需要他们执劫司职、奔走量劫，道祖需要他们制衡玄门、均衡诸天大势。
想通这一层，西方二圣心底最后一丝隐忍、畏缩、顾虑，彻底烟消云散。
从前的退让，是势弱无奈、以求苟活；如今的强硬，是大势在身、有恃无恐。
准提抬眸，先前隐忍的苦涩尽数褪去，眼底翻涌着几分张扬利落的笑意，不再遮掩、不再伪装。他直面元始冰冷刺骨的威压，语气从容，甚至带着几分刻意的轻佻。
“元始道友一再追责，无非认定我二人私窃天道机缘、坏了诸天规矩。”
话音未落，准提掌心灵光骤绽。

嗡——
一道清冽霸道的风之混沌本源，自他圣躯深处流淌而出，化作一轮流转万千道纹的混沌风轮，悬浮掌心。无边巽风道韵席卷四方，远超先天至宝的层级威压，瞬间镇压全场残余乱象。
几乎同时，接引抬手，掌心厚重苍茫的泽水本源缓缓升腾，化作一面澄澈厚重的混沌泽印，水光内敛、道韵沉凝，与风轮阴阳呼应、双宝和鸣。
双生混沌灵宝，彻底现世，当众展露真容。
并非离体飘浮的外物，而是与二圣圣躯、道基、元神完美相融，皮肉相连、道根共生。
灵宝流转的混沌灵光之中，隐隐缠绕着一层规整森严的天道纹路，那是宏愿立誓、天道锁位后，留下的永恒契印，密不可分、永不剥离。
天地间瞬间响起细微却厚重的道音共鸣，冥冥天道之力垂落，无声佐证着这份契约的绝对性。
接引声线沉稳冷冽，字字钉死真相，彻底断绝元始夺宝的念想：
“两件混沌至宝，已与我二人圣位本源彻底合一。非是我等强夺机缘，是天道借巽阵绝境，以此宝补我西方道基，重定圣位格局。”
“今日若有人强行夺宝，便是撕裂天道契约、损毁完整圣道，不止是与我西方结死仇，更是逆天道排布、违道祖暗局。”
准提顺势接话，笑意张扬，话语却字字扎心，刻意刺激着盛怒的元始：
“师兄口口声声要我等交宝，惩治我等违规。可如今灵宝认主、天道落契，大势已定。
若真有本事，大可先出手解开这天道契约、斩断我等圣道根基。若是做不到，便不必再空谈追责、强摆威风了。”
这句话，彻底戳中元始的痛处。
羞辱，赤裸裸的羞辱。
元始本就因接连错失机缘、被西方越级挑衅而满心憋屈，此刻被二人当众揭短、亮宝示威、言语嘲讽，心底积压的怒火瞬间轰然炸裂。
content_en:
The ruins of Fengze are empty, and the deathly silence of the Four Saints' confrontation still weighs heavily on the world.
The cracks in the broken void across the sky have not yet healed, and the remaining Xunfeng and Zeshui laws slowly dissipated. The remaining power of the tense confrontation is still shaking the four extremes.
Nine heavens in the distance, all the saints are watching in the air, their silent gazes are like eternal scales, hanging over the heads of every saint, weighing them down so that the whole game does not dare to completely collapse.
Yuan Shi stood high in the sky, his white clothes hanging down, and his whole body expounding the Dharma was as cold as frost. The anger that had just been forced back by the Second Saint of the West was suppressed in his chest, and he lost all face.
In his many years of knowledge, the West has always been a side sect that begs for luck, retreats when strong, and is afraid of punishment and power. Even if it gets an opportunity, it must be short-tempered and dare not take a hard line with Taoist orthodoxy.
But today, these two saints, who had always given in, turned the table over in front of him.
At this moment, Zhunti and Jieyin's state of mind has been completely overturned, and a complete transformation has been completed.
The fear of setting up the great ambition, locking the holy throne, and integrating the two treasures just now has completely faded away.
The hopeless fear of being cut off from the way of heaven and dying has turned into the most solid confidence.
The Second Saint's mind was clear and he had thoroughly thought through the entire chess game.
They seem to be shackled for eternity and reduced to the tools of Heaven. They seem to have lost the freedom of saints, but they are completely on the side of Heaven's trend.
Entering the game to seize the treasure this time seems to be illegal and private, but in fact it is a foregone conclusion with the acquiescence of Tiandao and the secret arrangement of Taozu.
Otherwise, with Hongjun's power to control the order of the heavens and control the rewards and punishments of saints, he would never allow the two of them to hold the chaos level treasure safely in the name of violating the rules.
The so-called Purple Sky's pursuit of blame and Heaven's punishment may look like a sharp sword hanging from the top, but in fact it has long been in vain.
They will not die, do not dare to die, and will not be severely punished. The way of heaven needs them to perform the duties of calamity and measure calamity, and the Taoist ancestors need them to check and balance Xuanmen and balance the general trend of the heavens.
After thinking through this level, the last trace of forbearance, shrinkage, and concern in the heart of the Second Saint of the West completely disappeared.
In the past, giving in was a sign of being weak and having no choice but to survive; today's toughness is a sign of being confident and confident of the general trend.
Zhunti raised his eyes, and all the bitterness he had previously endured faded away, and a somewhat open and bright smile filled his eyes, no longer covering up or pretending. He faced the cold and biting pressure of Yuan Shi with a calm tone, even with a hint of deliberate frivolity.
"Fellow Taoist Yuanshi has repeatedly held us accountable, but he believes that the two of us stole the opportunity of heaven and broke the rules of heaven."
Before he finished speaking, the light in Zhunti's palm suddenly burst out.
Buzz——
A clear and domineering chaotic source of wind flowed out from the depths of his holy body, turning into a chaotic wind wheel with thousands of patterns, floating in the palm of his hand. The boundless Xunfeng Daoyun swept across all directions, far exceeding the pressure of the innate treasure, and instantly suppressed the remaining chaos in the entire place.
Almost at the same time, Jie Yin raised his hand, and the thick and vast source of the water in his palm slowly rose up, turning into a clear and thick chaotic water seal. The water light was restrained and the Taoist rhyme was condensed, echoing the yin and yang of the wind wheel, and the two treasures harmoniously singing.
The twin Chaos Spiritual Treasures have completely appeared in the world and revealed their true appearance in public.
It is not an external object floating away from the body, but is perfectly integrated with the two holy bodies, Tao foundation and soul, connected with skin and flesh, and symbiotic with Tao roots.
In the chaotic aura of the spiritual treasure flowing, there is a layer of neat and strict patterns of heavenly law. It is the eternal seal left after the great wish is sworn and the heavenly law is locked. It is inseparable and will never be peeled off.
A subtle but thick resonance of the Tao sounded instantly between heaven and earth, and the power of the heavenly Tao fell, silently proving the absolute nature of this contract.
The lead voice was calm and cold, nailing the truth every word, completely cutting off Yuan Shi's thoughts of seizing the treasure:
"The two treasures of chaos have been completely integrated with the origin of our two holy thrones. It is not that we took the opportunity by force, but that Heaven took advantage of the desperate situation of the Sunda Formation to use this treasure to supplement our Western Dao foundation and reset the pattern of the holy throne."
"If someone forcibly seizes the treasure today, it will tear the contract of heaven and destroy the entire holy way.It is a deadly feud with me, the West, and it goes against the arrangement of Heaven and Dao Ancestor. "
Zhunti took advantage of the situation and answered the words with a bright smile, but every word he spoke touched his heart, deliberately stimulating the angry Yuan Shi:
“Senior brother keeps asking me to hand over the treasure and punish us for violating the rules. But now that the Lingbao has recognized its master and the heavenly law has entered into a contract, the situation has been decided.
If you really have the ability, you can take action first to untie this heavenly contract and cut off the foundation of our holy path. If it cannot be done, there is no need to talk about accountability and impose authority. "
This sentence completely hit Yuan Shi's pain point.
Humiliation, naked humiliation.
Yuan Shi was already feeling aggrieved because he had missed opportunities one after another and was provoked by the West. Now he was exposed in public by the two men, showed off their treasures in demonstration, and ridiculed them verbally. The anger that had accumulated in his heart exploded in an instant.
